defects.claim_says: The level IV placement of the Executive Secretary, President's Commission on Law Enforcement and Administration of Justice continued, amended by EO 11409 (1968-04-29), until EO 11708 revoked it on 1973-03-23
defects.source_says: Held EO 11236 (30 FR 9349) sec. 8: the Commission "shall present a final report and recommendations not later than eighteen months from the date of this order" (July 23, 1965) and "shall terminate not later than ninety days after presenting such final report"; the OFR catalog note on EO 11236 says the same; no held order extends it
defects.problem: Held evidence indicates the office this clause placed ceased to exist (the Commission terminated under its own terms, apparently in 1967) before EO 11409 rewrote the item in 1968. The strike-and-insert continuation presupposes a live clause; the possible earlier end (body abolished) is neither resolved nor recorded as a gap, so the exact first end 1973-03-23 is not established.

defects.problem: The statement is inaccurate and the legal reasoning is wrong: an earlier lapse of the office would be this clause's first end, so the question is needed; textual survival of the item in EO 11248 does not show legal operation.
